key_insight: Normalizing flows can represent unitary gates as transformations between phase-space probability distributions, enabling a generative-model approach to classical quantum circuit simulation.
engineering_relevance: This framework offers a potential route to more accurate classical simulation of large quantum circuits using neural generative models.
method: Represent N-qubit states as probability distributions on a smooth 2N-dimensional manifold.
Parameterize unitary gates with normalizing flows between these distributions.
Learn phase-space representations of quantum circuits.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluation on three common circuit families, with accuracy exceeding state-of-the-art neural network methods at large system sizes.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify training costs or runtime scaling, so improved accuracy should not be equated with computational efficiency.
paper_title: Normalizing Flows for Classical Simulation of Quantum Circuits in Phase Space
